conflicts_and_limits: Nonroot, containers and encrypted secret storage do not automatically prove isolation, privilege prevention or runtime secret safety.
Commit signatures and interactive signing do not guarantee independent human authorship or reviewed content.
Accumulated lower severity vulnerabilities enlarge attack surface but do not automatically acquire a critical severity rating.
Source remote-access approval language is guidance, not an override of the user's actual authorized bounded workflow.
Organization port visibility and Codespaces feature availability require real supported-platform and audience checks.
